title: Render-pipeline changes become rules
text: Turn the render-pipeline family into rules (draw texture / render pipeline / texture view), then re-run step 7 to a build.
result: The GUI render family is rules in yarn and official names, each tied to the update that changed it: the render type first in every blit (1.21.2), the RenderPipeline (1.21.6), shader colour into each draw call (1.21.6), blend, depth and cull state (1.21.5), texture-id binds (1.21.5) and texture views (1.21.6). They replace the two whole-jump drawTexture rules. On AppleSkin 1.20.1 → 1.21.6 no render error is left; it still stops at 11 errors outside rendering (step 7).
